title: Graton Casino Expansion
summary: This note details the coordination challenges faced during the Graton Casino Expansion, a $2.9M project. The owner managed competing priorities between internal teams and external stakeholders, including architects, general contractors, and global supply vendors. The process involved establishing weekly coordination meetings to find compromises and presenting options to the client.

key_points.text: Coordinated between internal teams and external stakeholders including architects, general contractors, and global supply vendors
Challenge involved competing priorities: customer wanted premium customizations, vendors pushed back on timeline feasibility, and internal team worried about scope creep
Task was to align all parties and deliver the project without any financial overruns or delays
Purpose was to understand each team’s constraints and come up with compromises like identifying which customizations could be adopted without impacting deadlines greatly
Presented all possible options to the client with cost and time implications
Delivered the $2.9M project with over $400k in customizations on schedule
